subject: Phantom
text: Phantom has 360 Hit Points and casts Rub, XXXX, and Stone.

evidence.quote:
This undead menace hits hard, uses nasty spells like Rub, XXXX, and Stone,
and has a fairly decent set of Hit Points (360 of them).

subject: Phantom
text: Phantom is weak to Fire and Harm spells such as Fir3, Hrm2, Hrm3, and Hrm4, as well as items like Light Axes and Mage Staff.

evidence.quote:
That being said,
you will be able to really lay into this guy because of his double
weaknesses (Fire and Harm), so use Fir3, Hrm2, Hrm3, Hrm4, and even Light
Axes (Hrm2) and Mage Staff (Fir2) as Items.

subject: Phantom
text: Defeating Phantom awards 1 Experience Point and 1 Gold Piece.

evidence.quote: Enjoy your 1 Experience Point and 1 Gold Piece!

subject: Lich
text: The second encounter with Lich has 400 H.P., awards 1 Gold and 2000 Exp., and uses spells such as Nuke, XXXX, Stop, and Zap.

evidence.quote:
H.P.: 400

Gold: 1

Exp.: 2000...Lich returns, this time sporting a few new tricks instead of his Ice2
and Slep spells, which are the deadly Nuke (100-400 Hit Points removed from
all party members), XXXX, Stop, and Zap!!

subject: Lich
text: Lich's second form is vulnerable to physical attacks from Knight, Master, and Ninja, as well as Harm and Fire spells from Wizards.

evidence.quote:
However, attack with your
Knight/Master/Ninja, and use Harm and Fire spells with your Wizards to
quickly put this Fiend back to sleep.

subject: Kary
text: Kary's second encounter has 600 H.P., rewards 1 Gold and 2000 Exp., and utilizes Fir2, Rub, and party-stunning attacks.

evidence.quote:
H.P.: 600

Gold: 1

Exp.: 2000...her true power lies in her use of Fir2, Rub, and 
her ability to stun your party members.

subject: Kary
text: Against Kary's second form, Knight and Master should attack while Red Wizard, Ninja, and Black Wizard cast Fast and White Wizard casts Inv2 and Cure.

evidence.quote:
This fight will require a few simple
steps to assure your victory, which are: Knight and Master attack, Red
Wizard, Ninja, and Black Wizard use Fast on the proficient weaponry users
(if you feel it necessary), and White Wizard will use Inv2 and then Cure
any ailing allies.

subject: Kraken
text: Kraken's second encounter has 800 H.P., gives 1 Gold and 2000 Exp., uses Ink and Lit2, and can land up to 8 Hits dealing over 100 Hit Points of Damage.

evidence.quote:
H.P.: 800

Gold: 1

Exp.: 2000...He does have on attack that is essentially a waste of a
turn (Ink, which is a Dark spell), but he can land up to 8 Hits at a time,
allowing him to deal well over 100 Hit Points of Damage!...Also note that
he has added Lit2 to his arsenal of attacks

subject: Kraken
text: Strategy against Kraken's second form involves casting Fast on hard physical hitters, Inv2 with the White Wizard, and using Cure spells.

evidence.quote:
To take him down, have your Red Wizard/Black
Wizard/Ninja cast Fast on hard hitters like Knights/Masters/Ninjas (maybe use
one charge from each), have your White Wizard cast Inv2 (may allow your 
characters to dodge an attack from Kraken), and have your attackers throw 
their best shots at the fiend.

subject: Tiamat
text: Tiamat's second encounter features 1000 H.P., 1 Gold, 2000 Exp., and attacks with Bane, Thunder, Blizzard, and Poison as hit-all abilities.

evidence.quote:
H.P.: 1000

Gold: 1

Exp.: 2000...Tiamat does boast  a moderately powerful Damage stat (able to land numerous
hits as well), he uses Bane, and he does make use of Thunder, Blizzard, and
Poison as a hit-all attack.

subject: Tiamat
text: Tiamat no longer has a weakness to Bane in this encounter.

evidence.quote:
He also no longer holds that very glaring
weakness to Bane, so do not waste your Red Wizard/Black Wizard spellcasts on 
it.

subject: Tiamat
text: Recommended tactics against Tiamat include attacks from Knight and Master, Fast on the first round, Nuke, Cure, and defensive spells such as Alit, Aice, and Inv2.

evidence.quote:
Instead, make us of the conventional tactics of: Knight and Master 
attack, Ninja/Red Wizard/Black Wizard cast Fast on first round, attack on the
second (you may want to use Nuke if possible), and your White Wizard is on 
Cure detail as well as some Alit, Aice and/or Inv2.

subject: Chaos
text: Chaos has 2000 H.P. and yields no Gold or Exp.

evidence.quote:
H.P.: 2000

Gold: N/A

Exp.: N/A

subject: Chaos
text: Chaos casts hit-all spells including Fir3, Ice3, Lit3, Tornado, Inferno, and Swirl, as well as the one-hit kill hit-all spell Crack.

evidence.quote:
He can use Fir3, Ice3, Lit3, Tornado,
Inferno, and Swirl for hit-all attacks as well as Crack (a one hit kill
hit-all spell).

subject: Chaos
text: Chaos can cast Cur4 starting on round 4 of combat to restore 2000 Hit Points, requiring at least 8 rounds to recharge.

evidence.quote:
He also has the absolutely dirty maneuver of casting Cur4
from the start of round 4 of the battle (with the recharge time on this being
at least 8 more rounds), refilling himself to 2000 Hit Points!

subject: Chaos
text: Combat strategies against Chaos include relentless attacks from Knight and Master, Fast and attacks from Ninja and Red Wizard, Fast and Nuke from Black Wizard, and Wall, Fade, and Cure/Heal from White Wizard.

evidence.quote:
Knight      : He attacks and keeps attacking till his arm falls off....Master      : Keeps his fists of fury flying till he too can fight no more....Ninja       : Uses Fast to help get the good attackers throwing extra shots,
              then attacks as well....Red Wizard  : Have him use Fast, then attack once he is Fasted.  Also a
              part-time Cure/Heal user....Black Wizard: Casts Fast, then reverts to using Nuke and other attack
              spells....White Wizard: You may want to use Wall with her to protect some teammates,
              Possibly Fade to hurt Chaos, and then she becomes a full-time    
              Cure/Heal user.

subject: Damage
text: Damage is the weapon stat added to strength to determine attack power.

evidence.quote:
Damage is the stat that will add to your strength (although that stat has
   a formula for base Damage) to make your attack power.

subject: Hit%
text: Hit% determines the number of hits delivered by a character, allowing for more damage.

evidence.quote:
Hit% will
   determines the number of hits that can be delivered by a character
   (higher Hit% weaponry allow for more hits, hence more damage will be
    delivered).

subject: Weapons
text: Weapons with special effectiveness against certain enemy types (Coral Sword, Dragon Sword, Flame Sword, Giant Sword, Ice Sword, Rune Sword, Sun Sword, and Were Sword) do not function properly due to buggy programming.

evidence.quote:
One final note is that any of the weapons that have Special abilities 
   that make them more effective versus certain types of enemies (ie Coral
   Sword, Dragon Sword, Flame Sword, Giant Sword, Ice Sword, Rune Sword, 
   Sun Sword, and Were Sword) do not do so due to buggy programming.
